THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Garlic Parmesan Chicken Drumsticks + Chipotle Corn

Baking powder + dry rub is the crispy-skin shortcut — no frying, no flour. The same pan cooks drumsticks AND corn; sauce splits at the plate (chipotle adult / mayo kid). 350 cal / 30g protein per adult plate.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME50 min
COOK METHODSheet pan
EST. / SERVING~350 cal | ~30g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: PAT DRY FIRST. Paper-towel every drumstick before the rub touches it. Wet skin = soft skin.

Ingredients

PROTEIN

  • 6 chicken drumsticks (bone-in, skin-on)

SIDE

  • 3 ears corn, shucked

ADULT FORMAT

  • 1 big white plate per adult

Option 1

  • 1 small plate per child
  • 1/2 tbsp Chosen Foods Classic Mayo per kid (on the side, not on the chicken)
  • Cucumber sticks (1/2 small cucumber per kid, sliced into spears)

DRY RUB

  • 1 tbsp Clabber Girl Baking Powder
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp kosher salt
  • 1 tsp paprika
  • 2 tbsp Dan-O's Cheesoning

ADULT SAUCE

  • 1 tbsp Smoky Chipotle Crema per adult (drizzled over the corn)

Option 2

  • 1 small plate per child
  • 1/2 tbsp Chosen Foods Classic Mayo per kid (on the side, not on the chicken)
  • Cucumber sticks (1/2 small cucumber per kid, sliced into spears)

Allergens: dairy, eggs.

AT THE PLATE — sauce + portion + side veg. Same drumsticks, same corn, same oven cook. The ONLY split levers are: (1) portion (2 drums + full ear adult vs 1 drum + 1/2 ear kid), (2) sauce (chipotle crema adult vs mayo kid), (3) cold veg (cucumber sticks added to the kid plate only).

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.PREHEAT + RACK. Oven to 425°F. Set a wire rack over a rimmed sheet pan.
  2. 2.PAT + RUB. Pat all 6 drumsticks dry with paper towels — get the skin as dry as possible. In a small bowl mix the baking powder + garlic powder + salt + paprika + Dan-O's Cheesoning. Sprinkle the rub from a few inches up over the drumsticks, then pat it into the skin on all sides. Use your hands.
  3. 3.RACK THE PAN. Place drumsticks on the wire rack 1 inch apart. Tuck the 3 ears of shucked corn alongside on the same rack. Don't crowd — every piece needs airflow.
  4. 4.ROAST 425°F · 40 MIN — NO FLIPPING. Slide the pan into the middle rack. Don't open the oven for 35 minutes. At 35 min, probe the thickest drumstick at the bone — target 175°F+ for fall-off-bone tenderness (not 165°F). If under, give it 5 more minutes.

Adult — Big Plate, Chipotle Crema on Corn

  1. 5.ADULT PLATE. White plate. 2 drumsticks + 1 full ear of corn. Drizzle 1 tbsp Smoky Chipotle Crema over the corn (NOT on the chicken — the parm rub is already loud).
  2. 6.EAT WHILE HOT. Drumsticks are crispy at 5 min off the oven, chewy at 15 min. Don't let the plate sit. The chipotle crema is room-temp — pour cold straight from the squeeze bottle.

Kid — Smaller Plate, Mayo + Cucumber · Option 1

  1. 5.KID PLATE. Small plate. 1 drumstick + 1/2 ear of corn (cut the ear in half crosswise — easier for small hands). Cucumber sticks alongside. Small puddle of 1/2 tbsp mayo on the plate for dipping.
  2. 6.ASSEMBLY (kid leads). Most kids eat the drumstick first, graze the corn, dip cucumber in the mayo. Some skip the corn — that's fine. Cucumber sticks are the reset palate.

Kid — Smaller Plate, Mayo + Cucumber · Option 2

  1. 5.Same plate format as the standard kid plate, scaled to adult portion size. Mayo still on the side (not the chipotle crema). For kids who want heat, offer a small dollop of chipotle crema separately.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult — Big Plate, Chipotle Crema on Corn: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid — Smaller Plate, Mayo + Cucumber: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • DRY RUB ALL SIDES. The baking powder + spices need to coat the whole surface — top, bottom, sides, ends. Use your hands, get under any loose skin flaps.
  • RACK + SHEET. Wire rack over rimmed sheet pan. Drippings hit the pan, air circulates around the drumsticks + corn. Don't put chicken straight on the pan.

If something fails

Drumstick skin is soft / pale at 40 min: Either (1) skin was wet going in — pat aggressively next time, (2) baking powder skipped — the 1 tbsp is non-negotiable, (3) drumsticks were touching — space them out. Quick rescue: broiler on high for 2-3 min watching like a hawk.

Rub clumps in some spots, bald in others: Mix the rub in a small bowl FIRST, then sprinkle from a few inches up — gravity distributes more evenly than dumping. Pat the rub into any bald spots with your fingertips.

Corn is shriveled / dried out: Corn dries faster than chicken at 425°F. Shuck right before roasting (not hours ahead) and brush the ears lightly with avocado oil before they go on the rack. Pull the corn at 30 min if it looks ready; chicken can finish without it.

Kid won't touch the corn: Cut the corn off the cob into kernels and serve in a small bowl with the mayo. Off-the-cob kernels are a different texture experience — same flavor, fewer rejections. Save the cob for the adult plate.

Drumsticks done before corn: Tent the drumsticks loosely with foil on a separate plate while corn finishes. Drumsticks hold heat 10+ min covered — chicken won't dry out, corn gets the time it needs.

Adult plate tastes flat: More Smoky Chipotle Crema (~1.5 tbsp instead of 1) on the corn — the chipotle heat is the whole adult flavor lever. If the crema is too thin, stir in 1 tsp lime juice + a pinch of salt to wake it up.

Storage and reheating

Store: Best fresh — drumstick skin loses its crisp in the fridge. Cooked drumsticks hold 3-4 days in an airtight container; cooked corn 2-3 days. Don't pre-build the plates — cucumber gets watery, mayo separates. Assemble at meal time.

Reheat: Drumsticks: 400°F oven on a rack 8-10 min to re-crisp the skin (microwave makes them rubbery — don't). Corn: microwave 30-60 sec covered with a splash of water OR re-roast at 400°F 5 min. Smoky Chipotle Crema + mayo: room-temp from the fridge.

Lasts: Cooked drumsticks: 3-4 days fridge, 2 months frozen. Corn: 2-3 days fridge. Cucumber: 5-7 days whole, 1-2 days sliced. Smoky Chipotle Crema: per the cookbook page, ~5 days fridge. Chosen Foods Mayo: per bottle date, 2 months opened in the fridge.

Make this when

Watch the full cook

Brands I use

Dan-O's
Cheesoning Seasoning (2.6 oz — parmesan + Italian herbs + dried garlic)
The garlic-parm flavor shortcut. 2 tbsp across 6 drumsticks adds ~60 cal of parmesan total + the spice rack you'd otherwise measure 5 jars for. Cross-Dan-O's-family with id 40 Caesar Crunch + the broader Dan-O's lineup.
Chosen Foods
Classic Mayo made with Avocado Oil (8 fl oz squeeze)
Mild kid-friendly creamy option. Avocado-oil base is cleaner than soybean-oil mayo, and the squeeze bottle controls the kid portion (1/2 tbsp per plate). Egg-based — the only egg allergen in the recipe.
Clabber Girl
Double-Acting Baking Powder (8.1 oz)
The crispy-skin enabler. 1 tbsp raises the surface pH and draws moisture out so the drumstick skin browns + crackles in a dry oven — no flour, no frying. Aluminum-free.
The Split Plate
Smoky Chipotle Crema (indexed cookbook sauce — see /cookbook/smoky-chipotle-crema)
Adult corn finish. Yogurt + chipotle + lime = adult heat without a sugar bomb. Cross-recipe candidate with id 22 Smash Tacos + id 27 Chipotle Chicken Quesadillas. Plant-protein optional sub: any store-bought chipotle sauce.
